answer: Unchecked bot nodes flow into a network like an unmanaged glacial surge, overwhelming processing lanes just as a glacier crushes civil infrastructure under sheer volumetric weight. Applying congestion pricing to transactions forces every artificial identity to pay a resource toll, mirroring the root structure of a lotus that absorbs nutrients strictly proportional to its physical footprint. If malicious actors try to wander past checkpoints using free pseudonyms, they immediately trigger localized gridlock spikes that divert their own packets into costly verification queues.
